title: TaCraft Sociality-SMP
description: Since its founding in 2021, TcsCraft has been dedicated to creating an innovative and vibrant Minecraft survival and social server. Its core gameplay includes vanilla survival, skyblock survival, and skywars, and it now has over 7,000 registered players.
body:
# TaCraft Sociality (TCS) — Orange Server

**Founded:** December 8, 2021

Committed to continuous optimization and innovation, TCS has earned widespread love and support from the community.

## Key Features

- **Custom Plugins** – Maintained and updated in-house for smooth version transitions.
- **Active Tech Team** – High availability with rapid responses and efficient issue resolution.
- **Rich Social Elements & Village System** – Helps every player find a place to call home.

## Core Gameplay

- Vanilla Survival
- Skyblock Survival
- Skywars

## Community

**Over 7,000 registered players** and growing.

---

> Join us and embark on a unique and exciting Minecraft community journey.
